releasePolicy: A milestone is not shipped without verified production commit and playable URL

stages.title: Production reliability
acceptance: Exact SHA matched on real prod alias
Boot and interaction smoke on published 2D route
Rollback route documented

evidence.verification: Netlify build-environment COMMIT_REF, DEPLOY_ID, production context and site identity matched; runtime/assets matched; live browser start-shift and contextual NPC interaction observed.

stages.title: Character-anchored painterly art contract
acceptance: Compare actual barista/waiter PNG source pixels with scene assets
Paint a representative transparent prop with correct pivot and view
Actual Codex visual review of runtime-scale contact sheet under explicit owner delegation; owner inspection remains pending

evidence.verification: Painted table, actual reference contact sheet and delegated Codex visual assessment shipped in #112. Exact production SHA/assets and full five-role browser walkthrough passed; owner inspection remains pending.

stages.title: Replace unapproved SVG scene assets
acceptance: Ten quarantined vectors replaced by reviewed painterly PNG/WebP
All props match characters in 3 viewports
Strict art audit passes

stages.title: Real character sit/stand/drink/read/talk
acceptance: Real illustrated frames, not CSS scale hacks
States and transitions from idle/walk/sit to read/drink/talk
Anchors, collisions, layers and animation tested
stages.blocker: Requires approved seated/interaction artwork matching characters

stages.title: Purposeful NPC routines and safe navigation
acceptance: All six NPCs have a safe deterministic day routine
No indefinite furniture stall, interaction tracks current position
Gameplay and runtime tests; verified production slice

stages.title: Relaxed role/task/day gameplay
acceptance: All five roles playable start-to-finish
Three tasks, dialogue, next day replay work
Interaction affordances clear on touch and keyboard

evidence.verification: All five roles completed three tasks, finished shifts and advanced days using real keyboard/buttons on production Canvas fallback; default-renderer boot and input passed at 3 viewports.

stages.title: Cross-device QA, accessibility and performance
acceptance: Recorded desktop and 2 mobile viewport captures
Keyboard/touch/focus/reduced motion assertions
Measured device FPS and memory; no P0/P1

stages.title: Final release acceptance
acceptance: All mandatory milestones have evidence
Art owner-approved, strict policy green
Final prod SHA verified, game URL playable, rollback documented
stages.blocker: All earlier milestones must be done

historicalRelease.note: Historical observation only; always recheck current deployment. Vercel quota caused blocked newer releases.
